issues.on_page: Local fees, licenses, commissions, and miscellaneous 8,175,075
issues.issue: config/category_decisions.csv has a label-level decision for this exact label: licenses and permits, detail 'Licenses, Fees and Taxes'. The extraction uses charges for services/fees and other charges for services here and in all 8 detail lines (detail[3], [104], [120], [134], [143], [149], [157], [168]), so user_rules.py will likely overwrite it. Also, the Statement of Activities (p2) prints Charges for Services 6,113,731 + Miscellaneous local 2,061,344 = 8,175,075 exactly. Under the 2026-11-06 mixed-label ruling that could support a split; the extraction kept the line whole.

The statement line is one category, but in the detail the same label in the COVID ARP fund (detail[114], p8) is federal grants. So the same label carries different categories, and the federal ARP money counts as state aid at statement level. The Statement of Activities (p2) prints Operating Grants and Contributions 9,208,316 + Intergovernmental receipts 1,728,915 = 10,937,231.

issues.on_page: Veterans Service Officer, printed under the PUBLIC WORKS heading
issues.issue: As printed on p17 (detail[94]-[98]). However, the p5 budget schedule counts the VSO Equipment rental 3,900 under Public Welfare and Social Services (124,298 = 120,138 + 260 + 3,900), while p17 puts it under Public Works. Function totals differ between p5 and p17 (Public Works 442,719 + capital 2,000 = 444,719 vs 448,619 on p17) although the grand total 10,182,488 agrees. This internal inconsistency in the report is not recorded in report_discrepancies. Veterans services would normally be health/welfare.

issues.on_page: Keno Fund: Local fees, licenses, commissions, and miscellaneous 523,672
issues.issue: The Keno Fund's main receipt is most likely keno proceeds (keno/lottery), but the label is generic, so the category stays a judgment call. Keno Fund Operating expenses 241,658 (detail[144]) was put in general government without a printed function (could be Community Betterment).

issues.on_page: Other Nonmajor Funds: Personnel services 1,098,122, Operating expenses 1,339,475, Supplies and materials 289,357, Equipment rental 23,688
issues.issue: Spending in the combined 'Other Nonmajor Funds' column has category other (detail[169]-[172]) because no function is printed for that column. Defensible, but other is a last resort. Self Insurance Fund spending (detail[135]-[136]) was likewise put in general government with no printed function.
